findings: The prior 55.40% win rate is 1,925 winners among 3,475 evaluated unconstrained signal events, not the funded-account sample.
Among the 90 actually funded RSI events, 82 have evaluated outcomes in the unchanged older study; those 82 contain34 winners (41.46%) and average -1.38% under the old assumptions.

The actual RSI account has87 settled cohorts,32 winners and55 losers; its average winner is+7.81% and average loser-8.91%. Its closed P&L plus retained positions reconciles to the -439,298.18 NTD account loss.
Different sample membership, weights, overlapping-signal funding, prices, exit timing, fees and capacity are jointly different. No single-factor causal share of the performance gap is inferred.
POC priority has a lower settled win rate than RSI20, but a much larger average winning cohort in this realized path; its positive return does not remove its57.01% maximum drawdown.
A few residual odd-lot positions can remain during liquidation in addition to three active slots; raw holding counts are not a new five-stock strategy.
